responsibility: Implements GraphViz DOT emission for GCC control-flow graphs. It is responsible for opening and finalizing .dot dump files, rendering basic blocks as styled nodes, rendering CFG edges with colors/styles based on edge flags and probabilities, grouping loop bodies into nested subgraphs when loop information is available, and producing per-function DOT subgraphs via print_graph_cfg, making it the concrete CFG visualization backend rather than a generic graph algorithm library.
same_name_distinction: This is the CFG-specific graph dumper in the graph group: it emits GraphViz DOT files for GCC control-flow graphs, including basic blocks, edges, and loop clusters. Unlike graph.h, which only declares the small dumping API, this file contains the actual rendering and file-opening logic.
